address: Prandtauerplatz 36, Weißenkirchen in der Wachau, 3610, Austria
bio: A centuries-old wine farm has been transformed into the beautiful Holzapfel winery estate, featuring a small boutique hotel, an inviting restaurant and a gorgeous terrace set within an arcaded courtyard. The kitchen team serves up dishes with a strong regional character that are distinguished by excellent craftsmanship and flavour. Opt for the set menu or order à la carte. The estate's own wines are available to pair with your meal. The front-of-house team is friendly, attentive and always on hand....
